articles.title: 1 charge dropped ahead of second Frank Stronach sexual assault trial: lawyer
articles.summary: Frank Stronach's lawyer says one charge of sexual assault against her client in an upcoming Newmarket, Ont., trial has been dropped.

articles.title: Vaughan real estate agent pleads guilty to extortion plot in Project South case
articles.summary: A Vaughan real estate agent pleaded guilty to an extortion charge Wednesday for a plot discovered through wire taps in sweeping police corruption probe Project South.

articles.title: Downtown Oshawa has 2 new progressive councillors. Here’s what they want to change
articles.summary: Downtown Oshawa will be represented by two new progressive faces in municipal politics, who say they’re focused on a housing-forward approach to tackling issues in the city’s core and prioritizing input from residents.

articles.title: Durham police officer charged in child sexual exploitation investigation
articles.summary: A Durham Regional Police officer has been arrested and charged with seven offences related to child sexual abuse and exploitation material, Ontario Provincial Police say.

articles.title: Tedjo beat 2 incumbents in Mississauga's mayoral race. Here are his plans for the city
articles.summary: One day after a decisive victory, Alvin Tedjo announced his priorities as the next mayor of Mississauga, saying he will focus on affordability, crime, housing, transportation and the economy.

articles.title: Patrick Brown outlines key priorities after cruising to 3rd term as Brampton mayor
articles.summary: After comfortably securing his third consecutive term as Mayor of Brampton, Patrick Brown says he's excited to have a united council that will prioritize infrastructure and recreation projects, and focus on public safety.
